loftbuck: a sure-footed mountain climber the size of a pony, shaggy grey-beige coat, a crest of short pale spikes running down its long neck, two long swept-back curved ivory horns, long narrow face, big dark gentle eyes, split hooves, a ridged crest of pale bony spikes from crown to shoulders, frilled membrane ears, a second small pair of horn nubs above the eyes
terrace-doe: a slender hornless mountain climber doe, soft fawn coat dappled with moss green, very large mobile ears, a short crest of pale fur down its long neck, big wary dark eyes, a ridged crest of pale bony spikes from crown to shoulders, frilled membrane ears, a second small pair of horn nubs above the eyes
kerrow-leaper: a wiry gorge climber, slate-grey coat, very long powerful hind legs, short backward-curving horns, a crest of short dark spikes down its neck, sharp alert eyes, a ridged crest of pale bony spikes from crown to shoulders, frilled membrane ears, a second small pair of horn nubs above the eyes
drove-loftbuck: a heavy broad-shouldered droving climber, thick dun coat, a crest of short pale spikes down its neck, thick curling horns, a bronze bell on a worn leather collar, calm patient eyes, a ridged crest of pale bony spikes from crown to shoulders, frilled membrane ears, a second small pair of horn nubs above the eyes
mistwing: a broad gliding flyer with membrane wings stretched between long finger bones, a light hollow-boned body covered in pale grey-white down, a long finned tail, big round dark eyes, small hooked beak-like snout
basket-mistwing: a stocky short-winged gliding flyer with membrane wings, moss-green and cream down, a small woven moss basket strapped to its chest harness, big round friendly eyes, small hooked snout
veil-mistwing: an eerie gliding flyer with pale grey membrane wings that fade into mist at the edges, wispy smoke-like fur, big pale eyes, and a few small dark ringed leech-like creatures clinging to its belly
treeloper: a long-armed canopy climber with grey-green fur the colour of wet bark, hooked fore-claws, a long gripping tail curled round a branch, hanging upside down, round face with large amber eyes, two pairs of long arms, bark-like ridged plates on its back
gorge-loper: a strong-shouldered rock climber with slate-grey and moss fur, long arms with hooked claws gripping a root on a cliff, a long gripping tail, round face with bright amber eyes, two pairs of long arms, bark-like ridged plates on its back
reedcat: a lean long-bodied striped prowler, tawny coat with dark stripes, very tall narrow reed-like ears, lamp-bright yellow eyes, long whip tail, ears like tall split reed blades with tufted tips, two thin feelers above the eyes, a ridge of short quills down the spine, a tail ending in a reed-like brush
fog-reedcat: a lean striped prowler in grey-on-grey stripes that blur into mist, very tall narrow reed-like ears, pale lamp-bright eyes, long tail, ears like tall split reed blades with tufted tips, two thin feelers above the eyes, a ridge of short quills down the spine, a tail ending in a reed-like brush
market-reedcat: a small quick prowler with a patchy rust, cream and black coat, very tall narrow reed-like ears, one ear notched, cheeky lamp-bright green eyes, ears like tall split reed blades with tufted tips, two thin feelers above the eyes, a ridge of short quills down the spine, a tail ending in a reed-like brush
drove-cat: a rangy dun-coloured prowler with faint stripes, a thick ruff at the neck, very tall narrow reed-like ears, an old scar on its nose, steady lamp-bright eyes, ears like tall split reed blades with tufted tips, two thin feelers above the eyes, a ridge of short quills down the spine, a tail ending in a reed-like brush
ironback: a huge slow hauler with overlapping dark slate plates along its back, a broad low head, small kind eyes, thick pillar legs and grey-brown leathery hide
draughtkith: a big patient hauler with lighter rust-brown plates along its back, a rope harness across its chest, broad head with small kind eyes, thick legs
bell-ironback: a massive plated hauler carrying a great bronze drove bell in a wooden frame on its back, dark slate plates, broad head with small calm eyes
ferry-ironback: a wet, plated river hauler with rust-brown plates and a thick ferry rope hooked to its harness, broad head with small patient eyes
canal-wadeskin: a smooth-skinned wading swimmer with slick blue-grey skin, webbed feet, a long curving neck, a small sleek head with gentle dark eyes
torrent-wadeskin: a sleek streamlined swimmer with glossy dark teal skin, powerful webbed limbs, a long strong neck, a narrow head with keen eyes, water streaming off it
spring-hearthling: a small round warm-bodied creature that fits in two hands, soft cream fur, tiny rounded ears, big dark shining eyes, a faint warm golden glow from its chest, a seam of soft ember-like glow down its belly, two small rounded horn nubs
cinder-hearthling: a small round warm-bodied creature that fits in two hands, soft charcoal-grey fur, tiny rounded ears, big shining eyes, an ember-orange glow from its chest, a seam of soft ember-like glow down its belly, two small rounded horn nubs
